assessment: The manuscript introduces an important and innovative non-AI computational method for segmenting noisy grayscale images, with a particular focus on identifying immunostained potassium ion channel clusters. This method significantly enhances accuracy over basic threshold-based techniques while remaining user-friendly and accessible, even for researchers with limited computational backgrounds. The evidence supporting the method's efficacy is convincing. Its practical application and ease of use make it a tool that will benefit a wide range of laboratories.
